validity.researcher_notes: The sweep's mixed-diameter proposal came from visually reading SNGPL's cartographic transmission map (TransmissionMap042022L.jpg), which labels the Dhodak-to-Salsabil leg '12in' and the Salsabil-to-Kot Addu(KAPCO) leg '16in' in blue text -- a single-source, tier=medium finding per that shard. I instead checked SNGPL's own TEXT-TABLE asset register (the same 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' page used for the length confirmation above), which lists every named line broken out by diameter as SEPARATE rows whenever a line genuinely has multiple diameters -- confirmed by its own convention elsewhere in the same table, e.g. rows 32/33: '|32|AV22 - KOT ADDU|16|69.65|' and '|33|AV22 - KOT ADDU|20|38.01|', i.e. the identical line name appearing twice, once per diameter, matching the sweep's cited precedent rows (P4015/P4019/P4107 pattern). 'DHODAK - KOT ADDU' appears in this table EXACTLY ONCE (row 37, confirmed by grep against the raw page text -- no second 12in row exists), at 16in/77.79km. If the pipeline genuinely had a 12in Dhodak-Salsabil leg distinct from a 16in Salsabil-Kot Addu leg, this table's own demonstrated convention (as with AV22-Kot Addu) would show it as two rows; it does not. Two readings of two different SNGPL-authored sources disagree (map vs. text register) -- I am not able to fully resolve which is right (possible explanations: the map's '12in' label may denote a short lateral/gathering tie-in at the Dhodak field itself that is not part of the trunk-line length being tabulated in the network register, or the register may simply report the line under its dominant/majority diameter for aggregate network-length accounting). Given the text register is the more authoritative source type for a length+diameter data point (an asset-length table vs. a hand-labelled map image) and is internally self-consistent (it does break out other lines' mixed diameters when they exist), I recommend keeping the single '16' value, but this is presented as a concern for Baird to decide, not a unilateral override.

summary: P4104: LengthKnown=77.79km CONFIRMED via SNGPL's own live network-breakdown table (exact match) -- the drawn 49km route undershoots because it's a straight-line schematic missing the real Salsabil-compressor bend, not because the stated length is wrong. Diameter: REFUTE the sweep's proposed '12, 16' mixed-diameter change -- the same SNGPL text register lists 'DHODAK-KOT ADDU' as a single 16in line (and, unlike this line, DOES break out other lines' genuine multiple diameters as separate rows), conflicting with the sweep's map-based visual reading; flagged for a human decision rather than resolved unilaterally.
